record.question: Southern blotting analysis is used for all, EXCEPT :
options: Detecting the presence of mutant gene
record.explanation: Answer C: Studying a microarray. Southern blot transfers electrophoretically separated DNA fragments to a membrane for hybridization with a labeled DNA probe. A microarray is a separate platform; a Southern blot is not the technique for studying a microarray. Reference: https://www.genome.gov/genetics-glossary/Southern-Blot; https://www.genome.gov/genetics-glossary/DNA-Microarray. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
